thread:
ops-bot: ALERT: capacity provisioning failures in asia-southeast1 for GPU family a100. autoscaler reports repeated quota denies. severity: P1
sre_oncall: picking up. joining bridge: https://pager.example/bridge/4339876543
jamal: what's customer impact? any 5xxs?
support_ivy: several hosted customers report spikes in latency and intermittent 503s. about ~8 endpoints affected, started ~12m ago.
sre_oncall: infra logs show GCP quota denial when creating GPUs: \"quotaExceeded: QUOTA_EXCEEDED for resource 'GPUS'\". autoscaler stuck at retries. snippet:
```
[2026-03-17T02:12:34Z] compute.instances.insert failed: quotaExceeded
[autoscaler] attempted 4/6 scaleups; last error: QUOTA_EXCEEDED
```
lucy: we have spare capacity in aws-us-east-1 (ec2 p4d) and also a small warmpool in us-west2. Could we temporarily allow cross-cloud fallbacks for non-regulated customers?
maya: cross-cloud will need extra routing and auth changes but feasible for low-priority inference routes. latency hit ~300-600ms, cost impact noted.
ivan: I can toggle routing flag for 'best-effort' queue to use aws-us-east-1 as fallback. Will require infra api call and LB policy update.
sre_oncall: do it. Prioritize SLA_critical queues to remain in-region if possible.
ivan: executing:
```
curl -X POST https://infra-api.internal/policy/route-fallback -d '{"queue":"inference-best-effort","fallback":"aws-us-east-1","enabled":true}'
```
deploy-bot: rollout started: route-fallback v1 -> canary
support_ivy: posting status: \"Investigating GPU provisioning issues in asia-southeast1. Some endpoints degraded; mitigation in progress.\"
jamal: also open GCP quota increase request and CC cloud accounts team. ticket GCP-TKT-7890 created. ETA unknown.
sre_oncall: additional mitigation: drain and reschedule queued jobs from best-effort to fallback region; kicking an eviction for oldest jobs to reduce pressure on apac pool.
ivan: running admin action:
```
admin reschedule --from=asia-southeast1 --to=aws-us-east-1 --queue=inference-best-effort --max 400
```
lucy: after reschedule, pending queue dropped from ~7.8k -> ~2.6k. SLA endpoints p50 latency restored. some low-prio jobs delayed; customers on best-effort notified.
kelsey: note: cross-cloud introduces request headers rewrite for billing attribution. I pushed a fix to gateway to preserve token mapping.
sre_oncall: monitoring autoscaler metrics; backoff retries still logging but new scaleups to aws-us-east-1 are provisioning successfully.
jamal: also scope for short-term config: reduce batch size for large models to free slot headroom. I lowered default batch size for gpt-large to 0.75x.

support_ivy: sent targeted emails to top impacted accounts with workaround and ETA.
ops-bot: ACTIONS: fallback enabled to aws-us-east-1; 400 best-effort jobs rescheduled; GCP ticket GCP-TKT-7890 opened; warmpool request submitted for asia-southeast1.
sre_oncall: follow-up: request permanent warmpool + request quota increase with GCP sales. add runbook step: if quotaDenied rate > 5/min for >10m, enable cross-cloud fallback and notify SRE lead.
ivan: filing infra ticket INFRA-4332 to track warmpool and routing improvements.

deploy-bot: canary success. routing policy applied to 10% traffic then 100%.

sre_oncall: INCIDENT MITIGATED: SLA traffic healthy, queue stabilized. keeping bridge open for 45m to monitor. postmortem required and will include cost/latency tradeoffs for cross-cloud failover.

support_ivy: status page updated. will provide customer followups when GCP confirms quota increment.
kelsey: recommend next steps: capacity planning, add warning metric for regional GPU consumption > 85% for >30m, and exercise cross-cloud fallback in chaos tests.

sre_oncall: thanks all. great work. closing bridge in 30m. :tada:
